# Ship sprite list

Every sprite Ship can use. Read [art-brief.md](art-brief.md) first. Sizes and anchors are in pixels at density 1;
art delivered at double size sets `"density": 2` and doubles every number. "greys" means draw it in greys
and set `"tintable": true`. Sprites in the same "part" are used together, once all of them exist.

## Environments: `assets/environment/<environment>/`

One folder per environment: `tropical-sea` (Tropical Sea), `navy-grey-sea` (Navy Grey Sea), `twilight-clouds` (Twilight Cloud Sea), `deep-reef` (Deep Reef), `solar-sky` (Solar Sky), `marigold-night` (Marigold Night), `neon-mist` (Neon Mist), `aegean-shallows` (Aegean Shallows), `cedar-fjord` (Cedar Fjord).

| id | size | anchor | greys | part | what |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sky` | 1920 × 1080 | (0, 0) |  | sky | The sky, stretched to fill the screen. Anchor: the top-left corner. |
| `clouds` | 2048 × 512 | (0, 0) |  | clouds | A cloud bank that tiles sideways, over the sky. Anchor: the top-left corner. |
| `waves-back` | 2048 × 512 | (0, 96) |  | waves | The far wave band, tiling sideways. Anchor: the left end of its crest line. |
| `waves-mid` | 2048 × 512 | (0, 96) |  | waves | The middle wave band, just behind the ship. Anchor: the left end of its crest line. |
| `waves-front` | 2048 × 512 | (0, 96) |  | waves | The near wave band, over the hull's waterline. Anchor: the left end of its crest line. |

## Ships: `assets/ships/<ship>/`

Every ship folder holds the same pieces:

| id | size | anchor | greys | part | what |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hull-back` | 1000 × 300 | (500, 150) |  | hull | Behind the sailors: the deck surface, far rail, raised-deck walls and cabins. Anchor: the main deck line at the ship's middle. |
| `rigging` | 1200 × 700 | (600, 700) |  | hull | Masts, yards, crow's nest, stays and the flag pole, without sails. Anchor: deck level at the ship's middle. |
| `hull-front` | 1000 × 300 | (500, 150) |  | hull | In front of the sailors' feet: the hull side, near rail, portholes, gun ports. Same frame as hull-back. |
| `cabin-decor` | 240 × 240 | (120, 236) |  | cabin-decor | The ship's themed keepsake for the Captain's Quarters. Anchor: where it stands on the floor. |
| `cabin-room` | 1000 × 640 | (0, 0) |  | cabin-room | The Captain's Quarters backdrop: walls, bookshelf, rug, lantern. Leave the porthole circle see-through. |

Without `placements` in the manifest, the pieces go at `hull-back` (0, 0) z 10, `rigging` (0, 0) z 20, `hull-front` (0, 0) z 60.
Extra pieces (a bowsprit, wings, a leviathan) are listed as sprites and placed with `placements`.

Each ship below lists where the engine puts things on the built-in layout. Ship units have the main deck at y 0 and the
ship's middle at x 0 (stern left, bow right, y down). In the hull images that is column x + 500, row y + 150;
in the rigging image, column x + 600, row y + 700. Draw decks where the spots are, or put your own spots in the
manifest's `layout` (in ship units). The hull below about 30 units under the waterline is hidden by the front waves.
